question:
The following bar chart shows the exports (in Rs.‘10000) of an item from a country for 5 consecutive years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1616c0fb236d9a63389f8afedb983c869a75b143f83facc72629c094c1bf4454.png] 

What is the average value of the export of that item from the given country per year?
solution:
Calculation: 

Now, the average value of the export of that item from the given country per year

⇒ (46 + 58 + 64 + 72 + 76)/5 ×10000

⇒ Rs. 6,32,000

**∴ The average value of the export of that item from the given country per year is Rs. 6,32,000.**
